ऊषण: ऊषण (1) = मरिच (Bpn; Dgv; Dn; MW; Pr; Rn); (2) = पिप्पली (PW, = उषणा); (3) = the root of पिप्पली (पिप्पलीमूल) (Bpn; Dn; Rn); (4) = चविक (PW, = उषणा); (5) = शुण्ठी (Bpn; PW, = उषणा); (6) = चित्रक (Bpn; KB 2, p. 1466-1469).

ūṣaṇa, neuter (1) = marica (Bpn, harītakyādivarga 59; WIRM 8, p. 99; Siddhasāra-Nigh. 25; Pa. ra. 222; Nś. 303cd-304ab); (2) = pippalīmūla (Bpn, harītakyādivarga 64); (3) = śuṇṭhī (Bpn, harītakyādivarga 44); (4) any of the pañcakola-group of drugs (masculine, neuter?) (Bt.).
